subject.title: Require Codex scan artifact coverage proof

question: Should ClawHub enforce fail-closed `artifact_coverage` on benign Codex scan worker outputs as the new authoritative ClawScan worker contract?
rationale: The code defect from the prior review appears repaired, but this still changes the security trust boundary and accepted worker output contract in a way automation should not approve without maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept After Final Readiness
options.body: Proceed with this stricter worker contract once the draft is ready and maintainers are comfortable with benign outputs failing closed without coverage proof.

options.title: Stage Compatibility First
options.body: Keep current storage behavior while adding diagnostics or a dry-run path before enforcing coverage proof as a hard gate.

options.title: Pause Enforcement
options.body: Leave this draft paused until maintainers settle the permanent Codex worker output contract and rollout plan.

recommendation.title: Accept After Final Readiness
recommendation.body: Proceed with this stricter worker contract once the draft is ready and maintainers are comfortable with benign outputs failing closed without coverage proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main work changed the same ClawScan worker and scan-request paths that would absorb this rollout.
